about: The tracks, in the order the picker shows them. file is the track's data file in this folder; label names the run over the clock on a track that is not a circuit; note is shown under its name on the picker.

tracks.name: Nordschleife
tracks.label: Bridge to gantry
tracks.note: The real Green Hell on a tourist day: queue, traffic, 41 corners, shrunk to a third.

tracks.name: Laguna Seca
tracks.label: Three laps
tracks.note: Three laps of the Californian classic from a grid: the Andretti Hairpin, the Corkscrew.

tracks.name: Coast Road
tracks.label: Surf Town to the lighthouse
tracks.note: Made up for Ring Kart: a sunny sprint up the coast, switchbacks and dune jumps.
